# ECN-2026-033 - Change notice - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Reason for change
- Background: During routine maintenance and review of shot media consumption records for EQ-P2-L1-SB03 at Plant P2 line P2-L1, operations staff and maintenance engineering identified inconsistent media replenishment timing that contributed to variations in blast cleaning performance and nonconforming surface finish results. The existing replenishment practice relied on manual timing and operator judgment, which did not provide a consistent media condition for the downstream hot forge process.
- Purpose: To establish a consistent, auditable top-up interval for shot media in the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 to stabilize cleaning performance, reduce rework, and align maintenance activities with documented procedures. This change supports quality and process stability objectives and reduces reliance on ad hoc operator decisions.
- Rationale: Standardizing the top-up interval reduces variability in media size distribution and contamination levels entering the blast cabinet. A defined interval enables predictable inventory usage, clearer shift handover communication, and measurable maintenance workload. The selected interval is based on review of media consumption patterns, production duty cycle, and coordination with related procedures contained in SB-1031, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-04.

Affected items
- Equipment scope: This notice applies to Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3, identified as EQ-P2-L1-SB03, installed on P2, line P2-L1.
- Procedures and training: Existing operating and maintenance practices that reference media handling for EQ-P2-L1-SB03 shall be updated to reflect the specified top-up interval and associated recordkeeping. Referenced documents to be updated or consulted include SB-1031, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-04.
- Documentation: Work orders, maintenance logs, and process control checklists associated with EQ-P2-L1-SB03 shall include a field for media top-up events and media condition notes.
- Inventory and supply: Shot media supply procedures that service EQ-P2-L1-SB03 must account for the new interval so inventory planners can align supply deliveries and storehouse allocations accordingly.

Implementation
- New top-up interval: The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. This interval is the required cadence for adding shot media to maintain target media condition. Each top-up event must be recorded in the equipment log described below.
- Action items:
  - Update SOP-P2-L1-01 to include the required top-up interval and a step for completing the media top-up entry in the cabinet log. Cross-reference SB-1031 for acceptable media types and handling precautions.
  - Update SOP-P2-L1-04 to incorporate visual acceptance criteria to be observed at each top-up event and to define escalation steps if media contamination or degradation is detected.
  - Maintenance planners shall schedule media top-up tasks in the computerized maintenance management system for EQ-P2-L1-SB03 to ensure visibility and assignment.
  - Operators responsible for running EQ-P2-L1-SB03 shall be provided brief hands-on training that covers the top-up procedure, log completion, and recognition of media condition anomalies.
- Procedure for top-up event:
  - Verify safety lockout and follow SB-1031 handling precautions before accessing the media hopper.
  - Perform a visual inspection of media condition and document findings on the cabinet log and in the process control checklist referenced in SOP-P2-L1-01.
  - Add media to the hopper to restore the working level as indicated in the equipment setup diagrams; document the addition including time, operator initials, and media source lot identifier.
  - Observe blast performance on a representative workpiece and record any deviations; follow SOP-P2-L1-04 escalation if unacceptable cleaning results occur.
- Examples of documentation entries:
  - Cabinet log entry: time of top-up, operator identification, media lot identifier, visual condition code, observed blast performance note.
  - Maintenance work order note: top-up completed as scheduled, any abnormal observations, and follow-up actions if required.
- Records to keep:
  - The cabinet media log for EQ-P2-L1-SB03 shall be retained with the unit documentation and retained in the digital process log system per record retention policy.
  - All top-up events shall be traceable to a media lot identifier for incoming material traceability.
  - Any deviations or escalations shall be recorded as nonconformance reports and routed per SB-1031 and SOP-P2-L1-04 instructions.
- Monitoring and review:
  - Quality and maintenance leaders shall review media log entries for EQ-P2-L1-SB03 on a routine schedule to confirm adherence to the interval and to identify trends in media consumption or performance that might prompt additional action.
  - If repeated deviations from expected performance are recorded, a targeted investigation will be opened and referenced to this ECN for corrective steps.

Approvals
- Engineering approval: Maintenance engineering must sign to acknowledge changes to EQ-P2-L1-SB03 procedures and implementation responsibility.
- Operations approval: Line management for P2-L1 must sign to accept the operational changes and training requirements for operators running EQ-P2-L1-SB03.
- Quality approval: Quality management must sign to confirm the change aligns with inspection and acceptance criteria and that records required by SB-1031, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-04 will be maintained.
- Handover: After approvals, updates to SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-04 will be issued and distributed to affected staff and the revision history will reference ECN-2026-033.

Related documents
- SB-1031
- SOP-P2-L1-01
- SOP-P2-L1-04

Record of implementation and approvals will be attached to this ECN and filed in the document control system with the ECN execution notes.
